BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: I have some cracks in my brick house from settling, how do I fix them? ASSISTANT:

Cracks in brick houses from settling can usually be repaired with a mortar or concrete patch. First, clean the crack and remove any loose brick or mortar. Then, apply the patch to the crack and make sure it is smooth and level. Finally, ensure the patch is fully cured before finishing the repair.
